calls.title: Shailender Kumar and Graham McNicoll
calls.summary: The team discussed the setup of targeted feature flags and experimentation strategies using GrowthBook to enhance merchant-specific user experiences. Key topics included using merchant IDs in the SDK to create customizable JSON-based flags, which allow for personalized UI variations and targeted testing. The design of experiments emphasizes balancing statistical validity through randomization and cohort-based testing, with a recommended split of 50/50 for unbiased results. The integration of SQL-powered reporting was highlighted for its transparency in experiment analysis, while the discussion on self-hosting versus cloud options addressed security and user management. A strategic approach for PayU's lending business was outlined, focusing on merchant-centric experimentation and effective lifecycle management of experiments.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, feature flags, A/B testing, merchant segmentation, MySQL integration, experiment analytics
